descriptionHtml:
150 × 95cm. Bolsters on three sides. Air still moving underneath.

Brotherswater is a raised mesh dog bed with bolsters on three sides, XL only, 150 × 95cm, on a powder-coated steel frame with non-slip rubber feet.

A dog who has always slept pressed against something walks onto a bare raised deck, stands there, turns once and goes back to the arm of the sofa. Leaning is how they switch off. Most raised beds hand them a flat surface and nothing to lean into, so it stays empty.

This one keeps the airflow and gives them the edge as well.

What they get

  • Bolsters along three sides: A chin, a shoulder or a sideways flop gets something solid to land on.
  • An open fourth side: They walk straight on at deck height rather than over a wall.
  • A 150 × 95cm deck: One of the largest beds we sell, sized for large and giant breeds.
  • A powder-coated steel frame: The steel carries the weight while the mesh keeps air moving beneath them.
  • Non-slip rubber feet: It holds its place on tiles, laminate or decking.
  • Snap-together assembly: No tools, no screws, no bag of fixings.

Best for: Large and giant breeds who run hot but still want something to lean against.

Why it is worth the money

£155, and it goes into the two things a big dog tests hardest: the frame and the span of the deck. Powder-coated steel under 150 × 95cm of mesh. One bed covers summer in the garden and winter in a warm kitchen, instead of two that each do half the job.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

The honest part: 150 × 95cm is the outside measurement and the bolsters take part of it. A giant breed who sleeps flat out corner to corner will find it snugger than the number reads.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
XL150 × 95German shepherd, golden retriever, labrador, and giant breeds who curl rather than stretch

These are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Rinse the mesh and the frame down and leave it to dry. Check the rubber feet and the joints from time to time, and stand it on level ground.

Shade and water still matter in hot weather. A raised bed does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Can a stiff dog get on it? There is no wall to climb on the open side. We do not publish the deck height here, so message us if that is the number you need.

Is this the one for a dog who runs hot? It is for a dog who runs hot and leans. If they sleep flat out with no interest in an edge, Windermere and Bassenthwaite give the same airflow on a plain deck for less.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
